title: Normalize semicolon-delimited exercise types in the parser
acceptance_criteria: The raw parser record exposes exercise type values as an ordered, trimmed, duplicate-free array.
A semicolon-delimited Exercise type value produces separate values and rejects empty items atomically.
Scalar catalogue fields, muscle/source lists, numbered steps, common-error pairs, record boundaries, and report-level exclusions retain existing behavior.
Parser tests cover single types, multiple types, whitespace normalization, duplicate removal, and malformed type lists.
